monte.pt: Semana que vem, a esta hora, estarei deitado numa praia na Bahia.
monte.answer: This time next week I will be lying on a beach in Bahia.
monte.also: I will be lying on a beach in Bahia this time next week.
monte.why: Ação em andamento num ponto do futuro → will be + -ing. Truque ODU: AT / THIS TIME → continuous (fotografia).

monte.pt: Até o fim do ano, ela já terá economizado dinheiro suficiente para a viagem.
blocks: by the end of the year
monte.answer: By the end of the year she will have saved enough money for the trip.
monte.also: She will have saved enough money for the trip by the end of the year.
monte.why: Ação concluída antes de um momento futuro → will have + particípio. BY = prazo final.

monte.pt: Você vai estar usando o seu notebook hoje à tarde? (pergunta educada)
monte.answer: Will you be using your laptop this afternoon?
monte.why: "Will you be using...?" pergunta sobre planos de forma educada, sem soar como pedido direto.

monte.pt: Ele não terá chegado quando a festa começar.
blocks: by the time the party starts
monte.answer: He won't have arrived by the time the party starts.
monte.also: By the time the party starts he won't have arrived.
monte.why: Negativa do Future Perfect: won't have + particípio. "By the time" pede o perfect.

lacuna.q: By the time you arrive, the film ______ (start).
lacuna.why: BY THE TIME → prazo final → Future Perfect: a ação já estará concluída.

lacuna.q: Don't call me at 8 — we ______ dinner then.
lacuna.why: No momento exato (at 8) a ação estará EM ANDAMENTO → Future Continuous.

lacuna.q: At 10 p.m. the guests ______, but by 11 they ______ the whole cake.
opts: will be dancing / will have eaten
will have danced / will be eating

lacuna.q: By midnight we ______ everything, so the house will be spotless.
lacuna.why: Com BY + ideia de conclusão, use o Future Perfect.

opts: At 9 tomorrow I will be working.
At 9 tomorrow I will have working.
At 9 tomorrow I am will working.
corrija.why: O BE não pode sumir: will + be + -ing.

corrija.wrong: By June we will have finish the course.
opts: By June we will be finish the course.
By June we will finished the course.
By June we will have finished the course.

corrija.wrong: By 2030 they will be built the new bridge.
opts: By 2030 they will being built the new bridge.
By 2030 they will have built the new bridge.
By 2030 they will have build the new bridge.

corrija.wrong: Will you have be working tomorrow?
opts: Will you be have working tomorrow?
corrija.why: Não misture os dois tempos: escolha be + -ing OU have + particípio.

extra.q: This time tomorrow I ______ (fly) to Lisbon.
extra.full: This time tomorrow I will be flying to Lisbon.
By Friday she will have finished the report.

extra.q: Don't worry, I ______ (not / sleep) when you get home.
extra.full: Don't worry, I won't be sleeping when you get home.

extra.why: Pergunta do perfect: Will + S + have + particípio.

extra.q: In ten years, robots ______ (do) most of our housework.
extra.why: Situação em andamento num período futuro.
extra.full: In ten years, robots will be doing most of our housework.

extra.q: By the time you read this, I ______ (leave).
extra.why: By the time → perfect. leave → left.
extra.full: By the time you read this, I will have left.

extra.q: At noon we ______ (have) lunch with the director.
extra.full: At noon we will be having lunch with the director.

extra.q: By next month, he ______ (work) here for ten years.
extra.why: Duração até um ponto do futuro → perfect (for ten years).
extra.full: By next month, he will have worked here for ten years.
